newsitem.title: USA: Maine says unemployment dropped to 5.0 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Maine says unemployment dropped to 5.0 pct in Oct.

text.p: Maine said Tuesday its seasonally-adjusted unemployment rate was 5.0 percent in October, down from 5.1 percent in September.
"Seasonally-adjusted unemployment dropped slightly between September and October," said state Labor Commissioner Valerie Landry in a statement. "The number of unemployed declined by 1,200."
Seasonally-adjusted nonfarm and salary jobs rose by 300 between September and October, and were also up 300 over the year.
Between October 1995 and October 1996, the number of jobs in services rose by 1,800, wholesale trade added 1,100, retail trade increased by 700 and construction added 500.
Partially offsetting the gains were job losses recorded in manufacturing and government sectors.
